intro: Tourism and citizenship sales have replaced sugar in Saint Kitts and Nevis.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: The sugar industry closed in 2005. Tourism, a medical school and citizenship by investment now bring in money.

chapters.title: Sugar train
text: The old sugar railway now carries tourists around the island.

cardGroups.title: Made in Saint Kitts and Nevis
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Saint Kitts and Nevis makes and sells to the world.
